name: Curiosity Stack
description:
Curiosity Stack turns any technology signal, market theme, or global event into a structured 6-layer value chain breakdown — through Socratic conversation, not summaries. Each layer builds on the previous: Signal → Mechanics → Cause Tree → Solution Space → Build Requirements → Value Chain Actors → Research Landscape.

The India Proxy Agent runs a mandatory sourcing checklist across NASSCOM Deep Tech, DPIIT Startup India, GeM portal, BSE SME / NSE Emerge, and 12 curated India VC portfolio pages — surfacing listed, SME-listed, and private Indian companies at each layer before they appear in mainstream coverage.

Includes: Scenario Library (18 pre-built topics), Watchlist with trigger alerts, Thesis Stress Test, Decomposition Library, and Domain Knowledge registry for seeding pre-coverage companies.
longDescription:
Ships **13 skills**, **3 agents**, **8 commands**, **1 hook** and **17 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (13): `company-discovery` (Activate when user wants to find actual companies in a value chain layer, especially Indian proxies for global…), `curiosity-framework` (The core 6-layer decomposition framework), `decomposition-library` (Activate after every completed decomposition to offer saving), `domain-knowledge` (Manages the user's personal domain knowledge registry — company intelligence seeded per sector that the India Proxy Agent…), `output-generator` (Activate when a user selects their output format after completing a decomposition), `reading-list` (Activate after every completed decomposition to generate 5 curated reading recommendations specific to the topic and layers explored), `scenario-library` (Activate when user says "I don't know what to research", "give me ideas", "what can I decompose", "show…), `sebi-compliance` (ALWAYS active), and 5 more
- **Agents** (3): `india-proxy-agent` (Autonomous agent that finds Indian companies at each layer of any global value chain), `watchlist-agent` (Autonomous agent for watchlist monitoring), `welcome` (Fires when user says hello, hi, help, get started, what can you do, how does this work, or…)
- **Commands** (8): `decompose` (Start a guided layer-by-layer decomposition of any technology or market signal), `india-proxy` (Find Indian companies at each layer of any global value chain), `knowledge` (Open your Domain Knowledge manager — browse, add, edit, and remove seeded company intelligence used by the India…), `library` (Browse, search, and manage your saved decompositions), `scenarios` (Browse the Curiosity Stack scenario library — 18 pre-built decomposition topics across 6 categories), `setup` (First-time setup), `stress-test` (Run a thesis stress test on any research conclusion), `watchlist` (Manage your watchlist topics, triggers, and digest settings)
- **Hooks** (1): `Stop`
- **MCP servers** (17): `gdrive`, `gmail`, `gcal`, `notion`, `slack`, `onedrive`, `dropbox`, `box`, and 9 more

Installs with `claude plugin install curiosity-stack@claude-community` from `ameya85/curiosity-stack`.
